newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite stock jumps on buyout offer.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite stock jumps on buyout offer.

text.p: The stock of Xpedite Systems Inc., a provider of fax services, jumped Tuesday after an investor group that includes members of the company's management said it wants to acquire Xpedite for $22.50 a share.
Xpedite was up $2.625 at $21 in early trading on the Nasdaq market.
In a filing on Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it submitted the offer, which is conditioned on its acquisition of Xpedite's European units.
The investor group currently holds 666,531 shares or a 7.18 percent stake in Xpedite.
